verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs describe `pulumi import`, which adopts an existing cloud resource into stack state and generates the code needed to manage it (pulumi-docs-25, pulumi-docs-6, pulumi-docs-17). They also describe `pulumi preview --import-file` for building a multi-resource import file (pulumi-docs-21). Generated code must be copied into the program by hand, and the only community report (pulumi-comm-9, on large-scale tf2pulumi migration) concerns Terraform conversion rather than resource import. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of import plus code generation, evidence of automatic insertion of generated code into the program, documented depth on bulk import at scale.
